body.p: Two Evenkis were heading downstream. They put a vixen in the boat. They had bags of provisions with them.[StN]: syntax? They head downstream. They went and went downstream - then there is a small river. They ask: "Vixen, what is the name of this little river?" The vixen says, "It's reducing [literally, the upper part]!" They went downstream [StN]: ojolÉ£o - ((unknown))again, they went further downstream - again there is a small river. Then, he says, they ask the vixen again, "What is the name of this little river?"
